title: RPN Calculator
description: A real stack-based Reverse Polish Notation calculator: type numbers, press Enter to push, then apply + − × ÷, with drop, swap and clear stack operations.
howto: Type a number with the digit keys (or your keyboard) and press Enter to push it on the stack.
Type the second number and press an operator key (+ − × ÷) — it pops the top two values, computes, and pushes the result.
Use Drop to remove the top value, Swap to exchange the top two, Clear to empty the stack.
The X register (top of stack) always shows the current result.

faqs.a: In Reverse Polish Notation you enter operands first, then the operator: 3 Enter 4 + gives 7. No equals key and no parentheses are needed — the stack order handles precedence.

faqs.q: What do Drop and Swap do?
faqs.a: Drop removes the top stack value (X). Swap exchanges X with Y (the second value), which is handy before a subtraction or division when the operands are in the wrong order.
Yes — digits, decimal point, Enter (push), + - * /, Backspace to edit the entry, and Escape to clear the stack all work from the keyboard.
